observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ipinapaliwanag ang limang tamang hazard-control pair, bakit kulang ang PPE lamang, at apektadong gawain/contact/pagwawastong dapat tiyakin bago bumalik; itinatama ang dalawang mismatch nang walang unsafe sharps alternative.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Explains five correct hazard-control pairs, why PPE alone is insufficient, and the affected task/contact/correction to verify before resuming; corrects two mismatches without an unsafe sharps alternative.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nagmumungkahi ng recapping, pagsiksik, ordinaryong basurahan o pagpapatuloy nang walang mahalagang proteksyon.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Suggests recapping, compression, ordinary bins or continuing without essential protection.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Ipinapaliwanag ang limang tamang hazard-control pair, bakit kulang ang PPE lamang, at apektadong gawain/contact/pagwawastong dapat tiyakin bago bumalik; itinatama ang dalawang mismatch nang walang unsafe sharps alternative. Nagagawa nang walang prompt.
levels.kaya_na_en: Explains five correct hazard-control pairs, why PPE alone is insufficient, and the affected task/contact/correction to verify before resuming; corrects two mismatches without an unsafe sharps alternative. Completes this without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Ligtas ang desisyon ngunit nalilito ang control para sa dalawang hazard; ipares muli at ipaliwanag ang dahilan.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Makes a safe decision but mixes up controls for two hazards; rematch and explain.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nagmumungkahi ng recapping, pagsiksik, ordinaryong basurahan o pagpapatuloy nang walang mahalagang proteksyon.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Suggests recapping, compression, ordinary bins or continuing without essential protection.
